description: manni docs meta/reference/built-in-schemas, run in a Docusaurus site whose docs/install.md uses a tag object.

steps.description: manni meta schemas prints the registry from the installed version.
A platform schema and an editorial one compose in one run.

runShell.command: manni meta validate docs/ -s docusaurus:docs:3.10 -s diataxis:diataxis:1.0

steps.description: Turn one on from the command line: stacked with OKF, the tag object fails OKF's string-only tags.

runShell.command: manni meta validate docs/ -s docusaurus:docs:3.10 -s google:okf:0.1

steps.description: Turn one on in config: a default set and one override per content root.

runShell.command:
node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('manni.config.yaml','meta:
  schemas:
    - google:okf:0.1
  overrides:
    - files: \x22docs/**\x22
      schemas:
        - docusaurus:docs:3.10
        - diataxis:diataxis:1.0
    - files: \x22blog/**\x22
      schemas:
        - docusaurus:blog:3.10
    - files: \x22src/pages/**\x22
      schemas:
        - docusaurus:pages:3.10
')"

steps.description: The overrides apply: docs/ gets Docusaurus with Diataxis, so the tag object passes.

runShell.command: manni meta validate docs/ blog/ src/pages/
